Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a specialized IsoTOPP (isotope-coded tagging of proteins) approach for ABPP (Activity-Based Protein Profiling) to quantify covalent engagement of cysteines. While it uses heavy/light labels, it is a custom chemical probe strategy rather than standard TMT/SILAC, hence 'Other' for labeling strategy. The workflow is essentially an affinity purification mass spectrometry (AP-MS) approach targeting covalent adducts.

scope: the samples were solubilized and bound to streptavidin agarose beads in PBS for 3 h at 25 °C. The beads were washed, centrifuged, and resuspended in Tris 50 mM pH 8 and transferred to a clean Eppendorf tube. After this, the bound proteins were eluted by boiling with 5% SDS then reduced with DTT, alkylated with iodoacetamide, and digested with trypsin. The samples were run on LC/MS/MS.

Following the resuspension, the samples were diluted with PBS and incubated with streptavidin agarose beads 3 hours at room temperature. The beads were washed and the bead-bound proteins were reduced with DTT, alkylated with iodoacetamide and trypsinized overnight at 37°C.
